name: Self-order mobile menu screen
describe: MobileQR menu at 390x844: sticky blurred header ("Table 5" 18/600, "Start Over" border button), "Your order so far" card with Total row, category chips, search, 2-column product grid (gap 12) and a fixed bottom bar with "View Cart (3 items) • total" (rounded-md bg-primary py-3).
Use as the first screen after scanning a table QR code. RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels.
